shared_elements: human figure (drawn full-length in A; sculpted bust in B)
disc motif (sun disc in A; circular disc/pendant on chest in B)
justification: Both surfaces carry dense script-like signs and both include a disc motif and human figure imagery, which is a moderately specific correspondence, and B's incised chest ornament with a central round disc echoes the rayed disc in A's lunette. But A is a flat, register-ordered scene of standing figures adoring a rayed disc above many ruled lines of text, whereas B is a three-dimensional human figure whose body itself carries scattered relief signs and a necklace/garment scheme with no narrative scene or ruled text registers.
